extracted.name: Japanese Fruit Pie
extracted.description: This is a pecan pie with a fruity twist. Coconut and plump raisins are stirred into a sweet pecan pie filling and baked. Serve with vanilla ice cream or freshly whipped cream.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a medium mixing bowl combine eggs, butter or margarine, sugar, vanilla extract, and vinegar. Beat until smooth. Stir in pecans, coconut, and raisins. Pour mixture into pastry shell.
Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes. Cool before serving.
